column4: Continue the reference: identical flat side-view camera, the same black dressmaker shears in the same place and scale, but the two blades have just snapped fully shut into one straight closed line. The vertical thread bundle is cut clean through at the blades: the upper half of the threads springs up and away toward the top edge with frayed curling ends, the lower half drops and splays downward; an empty gap of ivory where they were joined. Flat empty ivory background. No hand, no text.
